description.undefined: Extending MarineTLO - a top-level ontology for the marine domain used in the context of the EU iMarine project.

comment.en: This class comprises the type of vessels that are concerns with the biotic elements of the domain of discourse.

This class comprises instances of BC20_3_Division whose extent may be used to define the location and spatial extent of property
rights or national borders.
This class allows instances of Country to be associated with any instances of CountryCode.
This stance is a domain specific individual to denote the uri use for the iso3_alpha code system.
This stance is a domain specific individual to denote the uri use for the iso_code system.
This stance is a domain specific individual to denote the uri use for the iso2_alpha code system.
This class comprises the type of classification systems used for assigning codes to instances of MarineTLO Entity.

This class comprises instances of BC20_2_Sub_Area whose extent may be used to define the location and spatial extent of property
rights or national borders.
This class comprises the type of gears that are concerns with the vessel type of the domain of discourse.
This class is a domain specific class to denote the particular instances of species that are from Ecoscope source.
This class is a domain specific class to denote the particular instances of species that are from Worms source.
This stance is a domain specific individual to denote the uri use for the global_statistic_landing.

This class comprises physical objects purposely created by human activity.
No assumptions are made as to the extent of modification required to just
ify regarding a vessel object as man
- made. For example, an inscribed piece of rock or a preserved butterfly are both regarded as instances of E22 Man
- Made Object. [ Scope Note for E22 Man - Made Object CIDOC CRM version 5.1.2]

This class comprises specific systems consisting of marine observable material items, biotic, abiotic elements and interactions, as well as their associated relations and qualities in space time volume. Its coherence can be defined by the types of species and the types and frequency of interactions which can be observed in a space time volume.
This class allows instances of BC32_Identifier to be specific for the reference citation.
This class allows instances of BC32_Identifier to be specific for the code of vessels.

This class comprises the actions of making assertions about the assignment of a scientific name of an object or any
relation between two items or concepts.

This class allows instances of BC32_Identifier to be specific for the code of water area.
This class comprises the particular appellations used for a group of people w.r.t country, language, etc.

This property allows instances of Biotic Element Type to assign its scientific name.
This property assigns name of a reference resource.
This property assigns note to a bibliography resource.
This property allows instances of Biotic Element to be component type of MarineTLO Type.
This property expresses the the ecological state of a species being native to a defined geographic location, such as an island, nation, country or other defined zone, or habitat type.
This data type property is used to assign a specific appellation - name - to a MarineTLO entity.
This property assigns the right associated with a bibliography resource.
This property expresses the the ecological state of a species being unique to a defined geographic location, such as an island, nation, country or other defined zone, or habitat type.
This property assigns the data of the event "Identifier Assignment" .
This property expresses the biological association of "being competitor” between two types of biotic element.
This data type property is used to assign a source of information cited, e.g. book or article, of a MarineTLO entity.

This property expresses the biological association of "any kind” between two types of biotic element. It is used when there is not much information available to establish the nature of the association.
This property allows instances of BC32_Identifier to be typed.
This property assigns the sourse in which a reference resource has been publishied.

This data type property is used to assign a appellation to a MarineTLO entity.
This property assigns the key words describing a bibliography.
This property assigns the accessed data of a Webgraphy Citation.
This property assigns the accessed info  of a Webgraphy Citation.
This property allows instances of Biotic Element Type to assign its authorship.
This property assigns the abbreviation of a country (e.g. GR, IT, FR, UK, etc).
This property assignes the publisher's description related to a bibliography resource.
This property is used to assign a conceptual object, e.g. book or article, where a MarineTLO entity is documented.
This property assigns a title to works, such as texts, artworks or pieces of music.
This property identifies a specific E29 Design or Procedure used in an Event.
This property assigns a format (e.g. pdf, word, etc) to a bibliography resource.
This property assigns the language related to MarineTLO Entity.
This property expresses the the ecological state of a species being brought to a defined geographic location, such as an island, nation, country or other defined zone, or habitat type.

This property expresses the the ecological state of a species being eradicate or destroy completely to a defined geographic location, such as an island, nation, country or other defined zone, or habitat type.
This property allows instances of MarineTLO Entity to be associated with activity types.

ho holds the instances of E30 Right to an E72 Legal
Object.

This property assigns a code/identifier to a Water Area.
